title: Fit a detector inside a measured deployment envelope
description: Change the tensor shape, batch, memory budget, observed latency, traffic, and deadline. The lab exposes exact input-buffer arithmetic and never substitutes generic YOLO benchmark claims for measurements from your target runtime.

valueFormats.label: FP16 input tensor
valueFormats.detail: Two bytes per RGB tensor value. Runtime support and internal precision still require verification.

valueFormats.label: FP32 input tensor
valueFormats.detail: Four bytes per RGB tensor value. This describes input storage, not all runtime allocations.
